description: This file contains tests for the taxonomy mock service within a library management frontend application. It verifies functionality such as retrieving genres and tags, creating/updating/deleting tags, and assigning tags to books, utilizing Jest testing framework.

methods.name: beforeAll
methods.description: Sets environment variable for mock mode and clears local storage before tests run.

methods.name: test seeds are available
methods.description: Verifies that genres and tags can be retrieved and that the lists are not empty.

methods.name: test create/update/delete tag
methods.description: Tests creation, update, and deletion of a tag, ensuring the operations succeed and data is correctly modified.

methods.name: test assign to book and filter books
methods.description: Checks assigning tags to a book and filtering books by tags, verifying the correct book is retrieved.
